ops.value: killed by Rin on the embankment at about 20:47, finished while it was down
Rin searched the embankment: fresh scorch-marked tracks in the wet weeds and claw scratches on the door of hut 3, which is shut and does not give when tried, as if held from inside
ops.channel: Rin searched the embankment and hut 3 herself
ops.because: Rin looked for signs; the cinderling prowling here is drawn by the shard

ops.value: heard a struggle outside hut 3, then silence
ops.channel: heard it through the hut door
